summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PROPERLEAD CRM. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering auth (cookie login, /me, bad password), dashboard stats shape, leads list/filters/search, scoring (A priority = 100 with all 5 factors), create lead + notification, follow-up + CRM update, notifications list/mark read/read-all, user CRUD by super_admin, role enforcement (marketing 403 on /users and PUT /settings), settings GET/PUT, and REAL Resend email alert (returns status=sent). Frontend: verified admin login (httpOnly cookies), dashboard 4 stat cards + priority distribution + pipeline + per-wilayah chart, Daftar Lead shows 9 leads (8 seed + 1 test), detail dialog shows all sections + score breakdown +40/+20/+15/+15/+10 with Prioritas A/100, search 'Banua' filters to 1, CRM board has all 6 stages, Users & Settings pages load for admin, marketing user login hides 'Manajemen User' and 'Pengaturan Wilayah' nav items.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — a11y improvement, add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to LeadDetailDialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) CORS is set with allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, localhost:3000] with allow_credentials=True — already correct; note that env CORS_ORIGINS='*' is unused. Safe to remove from .env for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, leads, users, settings, email) once feature-stable.
seed_admin only rehashes password if changed but does NOT reset 'active' or 'name' — acceptable but worth noting.
send-alert endpoint always sends to logged-in user's email server-side (good — no user-controlled recipient, prevents open relay).
Cookies use secure=True + samesite=lax — correct for same-origin HTTPS setup.
Frontend uses withCredentials via axios (assumed) — cookies flow works as verified by /auth/me and /dashboard/stats returning 200.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login. Playbook mentions 5-fail lockout — NOT implemented. Low priority for MVP but worth flagging.
